name: pi-telegram-stt
description: STT orchestrator + bundled OpenAI-compatible STT provider for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Wraps the inbound voice/audio pipeline (downloads voice notes, runs STT via the in-package OpenAI client, sends a 🎙️ echo to the user, and feeds the transcript into the agent prompt). v0.8.0: subsumes the pi-openai-stt provider — the OpenAI-compatible STT client (POST /v1/audio/transcriptions with fallback-chain base_url support) now lives inside this package; the separate `pi-openai-stt` npm package is deprecated. The SttProvider interface stays as a private in-package seam (./stt-provider.ts) for future backends; the only registered provider is `pi-openai-stt` (default; selected via extensions.pi-telegram-stt.stt_provider). The 🎙️ echo is one feature of this package, not its purpose — the package name is the scope (STT orchestration), not a single feature. v0.7.0: bundled _logger.ts (was shared at extensions/_logger.ts in the source repo; now per-package so this npm package is self-contained and installable via plain `npm install` from the registry).
